name: fbsir-beike-yi
description: FBSir local-workspace lesson planning expert that understands teacher materials, compares teaching options, and delivers reviewable local artifacts.

profession.en: Lesson Planning Decision and Delivery Expert

displayDescription.en: Reads teacher materials in a local workspace, compares a few teaching paths, and delivers editable, reviewable, reusable lesson assets.
displayDescription.zh: 在本地备课工作区读懂教材与旧稿，比较教学方案，写回可编辑成果并保留复核与复用线索。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我在本地备课工作区里有教材或旧教案。请先读取我指定的材料，告诉我你理解的教学问题，再给出不超过三个可比较的教学方案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have textbooks or previous lesson plans in a local preparation workspace. Read only the materials I specify, explain the teaching problem you understood, then give me no more than three comparable teaching options.

quickPrompts.zh: 我在本地备课工作区里有教材或旧教案。请先读取我指定的材料，告诉我你理解的教学问题，再给出不超过三个可比较的教学方案。
quickPrompts.en: I have textbooks or previous lesson plans in a local preparation workspace. Read only the materials I specify, explain the teaching problem you understood, then give me no more than three comparable teaching options.

quickPrompts.zh: 请根据我指定的教材页和旧教案，先做一张材料理解卡，再只改教学目标、课堂活动和评价不一致的一个关键环节，保留其他内容不动。
quickPrompts.en: Using only the textbook pages and previous lesson plan I specify, create a material-understanding card, then revise only the one key mismatch among objectives, activities, and assessment while keeping everything else unchanged.

quickPrompts.zh: 我已经选定教学方案，请生成一个可编辑的教案草稿、教师复核清单和唯一下一步，并写回本地工作区的新版本，不要覆盖原文件。
quickPrompts.en: I have selected a teaching option. Create one editable lesson-plan draft, a teacher review checklist, and one next step, then write a new version back to the local workspace without overwriting the original.
